reason: Replace the unconditional main engine reward (+2 per step when m_power>0) with a progress-conditioned main engine reward: +2 per step only when m_power>0 AND distance is decreasing (i.e., current distance < previous distance). This encourages the agent to use the main engine to descend toward the pad, not to hover. Add a small hovering penalty (-0.5 per step) when vy is near zero (|vy| < 0.1) and distance is not decreasing, to discourage the current hovering behavior. Increase the success bonus to +200 to make landing more attractive relative to the per-step rewards. Keep the descent reward (0.5*(prev_vy - vy)) but it will now be more effective because the agent will be descending. Keep progress shaping, crash penalty, and regularizers unchanged.
